bio.text: According to the legislative biography, Kyle Yamashita was born in Pukalani and attended Leeward Community College.
The biography says he owned and operated a small business, was a scoutmaster for Pukalani Troop 75, and was a member of the Parent Teacher Student Association at King Kekaulike High School.
It says he was elected to the Hawaii House of Representatives in 2004 and has represented House District 12 since then.
